answer: In PoA, each validator’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust factorization propagates weight only from established, reciprocal peers; a freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. Even a dawn campaign using a cipher or altered pigment cannot manufacture trust without costly, persistent interactions.
